label: Bible Study
prompt: Call unto me, and I will _____ thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
note: Sometimes nicknamed 'God's phone number' — call, and he answers with great and mighty things.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as _____.
verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
note: Job can't see God anywhere in his trial — but trusts he'll come out the far side as gold.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; _____ be the name of the LORD.
verse: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
note: Job's response to losing everything: 'blessed be the name of the LORD' — worship through tears.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy _____; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verse: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
note: Isaiah's brutal audit: even our best behavior, self-made, comes out of the wash filthy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of _____. For without the law sin was dead.
verse: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
note: 'Concupiscence' — runaway desire, and possibly the hardest word to pronounce in the whole KJV.
